normalization: Certified nonnegative 32-bin full-bout RMS envelope divided by per-bin L2+1e-10
warp_policy: Fixed .1 source fraction, minimum cumulative Euclidean cost, equal-cost shortest-path tie rule, divide by selected path length
calibration: Use all previously frozen 20 candidate bout IDs per user, five per gesture; no reselection or target tuning
evaluation: Full frozen Day6 validation and Days7/8 descriptive-final bouts; same users, separate recording trials
scope: Retrospective full-bout coordinate replay and nearest-template readout. Oracle boundaries; no automatic onset, live behavior, probability-calibration or default-promotion claim.
